info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Chloride Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Chloride Recliner Detail Management API facilitates the creation and management of detail records for chloride recliners in the product catalog. This endpoint enables businesses to input specific attributes, features, and specifications related to chloride recliners, which are essential for showcasing products effectively. Typically, this API is utilized by product managers and catalog administrators who are responsible for maintaining up-to-date product information. By using this API, organizations can streamline their product data updates and ensure accurate representation in their inventory.
